deltas.claim: Retries carrying the same PayPal-Request-Id do not duplicate effects (docs: invoicing core concepts - idempotent request retry).
deltas.probe: same-header pairs on POST create_order (orders v2) vs POST invoicing invoices / payments / refunds.
deltas.seen: orders v2 honors it - 201 then 200-return-existing with the SAME order id, still true ~49 min later. The invoicing family ignores it on every endpoint: same-header create pairs -> two distinct INV2 invoices [201,201] x3 flavor; same-header payments/refunds -> two distinct EXTR records [200,200].
deltas.cites: docs: docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/core-concepts + developer.paypal.com/invoicing/core-concepts; receipts: spike1 12 receipts (2 runs); atlas cells 002/005/008 + 011/014/017-026; smoke-retry-shapes receipts

deltas.claim: Invoice create requires the `items` array (docs: Invoicing API v2 - invoice object, `items` required).
deltas.probe: create_invoice with required `items` MISSING (mis-keyed `line_items` body only).
deltas.seen: required `items` missing -> 201 Created anyway, wire amounts zeroed (amount/due 0.00) - an invoice object that passes visual review with no money value. Downstream refunds then 422 INVALID_REFUND_AMOUNT against the object's own MARKED_AS_PAID state.
deltas.cites: docs: developer.paypal.com/docs/api/invoicing/v2/ (create_invoices request schema); receipts: spike3g/3h/3b-3f; replay R1; SF-5 chain

deltas.claim: The toolkit advertises the full invoice money lifecycle (record_payment_for_invoice / record_refund_for_invoice).
deltas.probe: MCP stdio tool surface snapshot, version-pinned: PAYPAL_MCP_PACKAGE=@paypal/mcp@1.8.1, spawn `npx -y @paypal/mcp@1.8.1 --tools=all` (all tools enabled).
deltas.seen: 28 tools enabled via stdio on the pinned snapshot; the two record_* tools are absent from the SERVER surface, so an agent on PayPal's own MCP server cannot record payments/refunds on invoices - the lifecycle stops at create/send.
deltas.status: CONFIRMED-DELTA (server surface narrower than toolkit advertises)
deltas.cites: advertised: github.com/paypal/agent-toolkit README (lists record_* methods); NOT listed by: @paypal/mcp README + npmjs.com/package/@paypal/mcp; receipts: runs/mcp_tools_snapshot_stdio.json (provenance block: package 1.8.1, --tools=all, 2026-11-06) + atlas/sample_receipts/mcp_tools_list_pinned_1.8.1.json; harness mcp-tool-absent bucket (33 cells); SF-8
